title_en: Fudian Bank Co., Ltd., Dali Branch v. Yang Fengming and Dali Jianbiao Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. — dispute over execution objection by a third party
ruling_gist_en: Where a guarantor and a creditor bank agree to establish a guarantee deposit account, deposit a certain amount of guarantee money in proportion for fulfilling a certain guarantee obligation, the guarantor may not use the guarantee money without consent, the creditor bank has the right to directly deduct relevant sums from the account, and a guarantee period is agreed upon, it shall be determined that the parties have formed a mutual agreement on a pledge of money. The specification of funds in the guarantee deposit account does not equate to immobilization. As long as fluctuations in the funds correspond to and are related to the guarantee business and the account is not used for daily settlement, it shall be deemed to meet the requirement of specification of money in a special account as stipulated in Article 85 of the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Security Law of the People's Republic of China. If the creditor bank actually controls and manages the guarantee deposit account, it shall be determined that the requirement of possession of the pledged money has been met.

full_text_en:
Fudian Bank Co., Ltd., Dali Branch v. Yang Fengming and Dali Jianbiao Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. — Action of Objection to Execution by a Third Party

[Ruling Summary]

Where a guarantor and a creditor bank agree to establish a margin account, deposit a certain amount of margin at a specified ratio to secure the performance of a certain guarantee obligation, stipulate that the guarantor shall not use the margin without consent, the creditor bank has the right to directly deduct relevant sums from the account, and agree on the guarantee period, etc., it shall be determined that the parties have the mutual intent to create a pledge of money. The specificity of the funds in a margin account does not equate to fixity. As long as the fluctuations in the funds correspond to and are related to the margin business, and the account is not used for daily settlement, it shall be deemed to satisfy the requirement of specificity of money in the form of a special account under Article 85 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the *Security Law of the People's Republic of China*. If the creditor bank actually controls and manages the margin account, it shall be deemed to have satisfied the requirement of possession of the pledged money.

Plaintiff (Third Party Objecting to Execution): Fudian Bank Co., Ltd., Dali Branch, Address: Yunling Avenue, Dali Economic Development Zone, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province.

Responsible Person: Zhao Junfeng, President of the Branch.

Defendant (Applying for Execution): Yang Fengming, female, 49 years old, residing in Dali Economic Development Zone, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province.

Third Party (Person Subject to Execution): Dali Jianbiao Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., Address: Manjiang Area, Dali Economic Development Zone, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province.

Legal Representative: Liu Baocheng, Chairman of the Board.

The Plaintiff, Fudian Bank Co., Ltd., Dali Branch (hereinafter referred to as Fudian Bank Dali Branch), filed an action of objection to execution with the Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture Intermediate People's Court (hereinafter referred to as Dali Intermediate Court) against the Defendant, Yang Fengming, and the Third Party, Dali Jianbiao Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jianbiao Company), contesting the court's ruling dismissing its objection to execution.

Fudian Bank Dali Branch alleged: In the case of Yang Fengming applying for execution of the loan contract dispute with Jianbiao Company, the Dali Intermediate Court froze RMB 2,800,000 in funds in a margin account opened by Jianbiao Company at the Plaintiff's branch. This margin account was a special account of a guarantee nature opened by Jianbiao Company pursuant to a loan cooperation agreement with Fudian Bank Dali Branch to secure the loans from Fudian Bank Dali Branch for purchasers of housing units under the "Jianbiao Huacheng" building mortgage loan scheme. Pursuant to Article 85 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the *Security Law of the People's Republic of China*, which provides: "Where a debtor or a third party has specified money in the form of a special account, sealed money, margin, etc., and delivered it to the creditor for possession as security for the claim, if the debtor fails to perform the obligation, the creditor may have priority in satisfaction from such money," the Plaintiff has the right to be satisfied with priority from the funds in the margin account. The Plaintiff requested: 1. A judgment that the RMB 2,800,000 margin and its interest in Jianbiao Company's margin account No. 6596 at Fudian Bank Dali Branch Business Department shall not be subject to execution; 2. Confirmation that Fudian Bank Dali Branch holds a pledge over the RMB 2,800,000 margin and its interest in margin account No. 6596.

Yang Fengming argued: The *Personal Housing Loan Cooperation Agreement* signed between Fudian Bank Dali Branch and Jianbiao Company stipulated that Jianbiao Company assumed joint and several guarantee liability, not liability under a pledge of movable property. The agreement only provided for Jianbiao Company to establish a margin account and deposit funds at a certain ratio, but did not effect a transfer or deduction of the deposited funds as required for a pledge, nor did it result in the specification of the deposited funds. Therefore, the pledge was not established. The request of the Bank should be dismissed.

Jianbiao Company did not express its opinion at the first instance.

Facts Found by the Dali Intermediate Court at First Instance:

1. On January 28, 2010, the Board of Directors of Jianbiao Company passed a resolution to apply to Fudian Bank Dali Branch for a building mortgage loan facility of RMB 450,000,000 for the "Jianbiao Huacheng" project, and agreed to assume joint and several guarantee liability for customers who obtained mortgage loans from Fudian Bank Dali Branch for the "Jianbiao Huacheng" project. During the period from July to August 2010, Fudian Bank Dali Branch processed the approval for the RMB 450,000,000 building mortgage loan facility to Jianbiao Company for the "Jianbiao Huacheng" project in accordance with its internal procedures. On August 12, 2010, the Credit Approval Committee of Fudian Bank's head office reviewed and approved the grant of a building mortgage loan facility of RMB 450,000,000 to Jianbiao Company with a term of 3 years. On August 28, 2011, Fudian Bank Dali Branch and Jianbiao Company signed the *Personal Housing Loan Cooperation Agreement*, which stipulated: The parties would cooperate on the "Jianbiao Huacheng" project developed and constructed by Jianbiao Company; for home purchasers meeting the loan conditions, Fudian Bank Dali Branch would provide a total loan amount not exceeding RMB 450,000,000; Jianbiao Company would provide joint and several guarantee for the home purchasers; Jianbiao Company should open a margin account at Fudian Bank Dali Branch and maintain a deposit of margin not less than 5% of the maximum amount of loans disbursed by Fudian Bank Dali Branch, to be used to fulfill Jianbiao Company's joint and several guarantee liability; without the consent of Fudian Bank Dali Branch, Jianbiao Company shall not use the margin for other purposes. On November 19, 2012, Fudian Bank Dali Branch and Jianbiao Company again signed a *Personal Housing Loan Cooperation Agreement*, stipulating that Fudian Bank Dali Branch would provide a total loan amount not exceeding RMB 40,000,000 to home purchasers of the "Jianbiao Huacheng" project, and Jianbiao Company would provide joint and several guarantee for the home purchasers, with relevant terms similar to the 2011 loan cooperation agreement. 2. In 2010, Jianbiao Company opened a margin account No. "9700xxxxxxxxxx0990" (hereinafter referred to as Account 0990) at Fudian Bank Dali Branch, and began transferring funds into this account from October 2010. Subsequently, all funds in Account 0990 were transferred to a margin account No. "9700xxxxxxxxxx6596" (hereinafter referred to as Account 6596), which Jianbiao Company opened at Fudian Bank Dali Branch on June 17, 2011. From June 2011, Jianbiao Company transferred funds into Account 6596 as agreed, and Fudian Bank Dali Branch deducted margins for defaulted loans. 3. On September 8, 2017, in the case of Yang Fengming applying for execution of the loan contract dispute with Jianbiao Company, the Dali Intermediate Court froze RMB 2,800,000 in deposits in Account 6596. Fudian Bank Dali Branch filed an objection to the execution with the Dali Intermediate Court. The court issued a *Ruling on Execution* dismissing the objection of Fudian Bank Dali Branch. Dissatisfied with this ruling, the Bank filed the present action of objection to execution.

Opinion of the Dali Intermediate Court at First Instance:

Article 85 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the *Security Law of the People's Republic of China* provides: "Where a debtor or a third party has specified money in the form of a special account, sealed money, margin, etc., and delivered it to the creditor for possession as security for the claim, if the debtor fails to perform the obligation, the creditor may have priority in satisfaction from such money." Article 210, Paragraph 1 of the *Property Law of the People's Republic of China* provides: "To create a pledge, the parties shall conclude a pledge contract in writing." In this case, although Fudian Bank Dali Branch submitted the application of Jianbiao Company for the mortgage facility and the relevant approval materials of Fudian Bank, it did not submit the *Personal Housing Loan Cooperation Agreement* that could prove the existence of a pledge agreement with Jianbiao Company during the period from 2010 to August 2011. Due to the lack of the final agreement for cooperation on the Jianbiao Huacheng project, the evidence adduced by Fudian Bank Dali Branch was insufficient to establish that the fund flows in the margin account during the period from 2010 to August 2011 were specifically designated as margins paid by Jianbiao Company for home purchasers. The Bank failed to discharge its burden of proof that all the money in the disputed margin account had been specified, and must bear the adverse consequences of such failure. Therefore, its claims were not supported.

Accordingly, the Dali Intermediate Court, in accordance with Article 210 of the *Property Law of the People's Republic of China*, Article 85 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the *Security Law of the People's Republic of China*, Articles 64 and 65 of the *Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China*, and Article 90 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the *Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China*, rendered a judgment on July 9, 2018:

Judgment: The claims of the Plaintiff, Fudian Bank Dali Branch, are dismissed.

Dissatisfied with the first-instance judgment, Fudian Bank Dali Branch appealed to the Yunnan High People's Court, arguing:

Jianbiao Company and Fudian Bank Dali Branch established a loan cooperation relationship for the "Jianbiao Huacheng" project starting from 2010. Jianbiao Company voluntarily assumed joint and several guarantee liability for the mortgage loan customers and deposited margins at a ratio of 5% of the loan amount. After the credit approval was granted in August 2010, Fudian Bank Dali Branch and Jianbiao Company immediately signed the *Personal Housing Loan Cooperation Agreement*, and subsequently renewed it annually in August 2011 and November 2012. Although the first loan cooperation agreement signed after the credit approval in 2010 could not be submitted to the court due to the objective reason that the handling employee had left the Bank, Account 0990 opened by Jianbiao Company at Fudian Bank Dali Branch was the special margin account opened pursuant to the 2010 loan cooperation agreement. In June 2011, due to an internal audit finding that Account 0990 had been recorded under an incorrect accounting heading—"Mortgage Loan Guarantee Margin" was recorded under "25101 Company Business Acceptance Margin"—Jianbiao Company opened a new margin account, Account 6596, and the entire RMB 1,794,000 in margin from Account 0990 was transferred into Account 6596. Each deposit into the two accounts was supported by relevant vouchers confirming that the amount was deposited as margin at the ratio of 5% of the mortgage loan amount disbursed in the corresponding period, and the amounts could be matched one-to-one. Moreover, the deductions from Account 6596 were all made because the mortgage home purchasers had defaulted on their loans, and the Bank directly deducted the funds to repay the loans. In this case, Account 0990 and Account 6596 were special margin accounts established by Jianbiao Company for the guarantee business, not used for daily settlement. The funds in the accounts were already specified as margins, and the Bank had control over the margins in the accounts. Pursuant to Article 85 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the *Security Law of the People's Republic of China*, the Bank has the right to be satisfied with priority from the funds in Account 6596. The Bank requested that its claims be upheld on appeal.

The Appellee, Yang Fengming, argued: Fudian Bank Dali Branch had no evidence to prove the existence of a mortgage loan cooperation agreement with Jianbiao Company during the period from October 2010 to August 2011. The *Personal Housing Loan Cooperation Agreement* signed between Fudian Bank Dali Branch and Jianbiao Company in 2012 only stipulated that Jianbiao Company assumed joint and several guarantee liability, not a pledge of movable property. There was also no transfer or deduction of funds for the purpose of a pledge in the margin account. The deposits and withdrawals in the account could not be matched one-to-one, and the funds were in a non-fixed state. The funds were not specified. The appeal should be dismissed.

The Third Party at First Instance, Jianbiao Company, stated: There was no specific agreement between this company and Fudian Bank Dali Branch regarding a margin pledge. The appeal of Fudian Bank Dali Branch should be dismissed.

The Yunnan High People's Court, upon second-instance trial, confirmed the facts found at first instance. Additionally, it found:

1. From October 11, 2010, Fudian Bank Dali Branch granted loans to purchasers of housing units in the "Jianbiao Huacheng" project, and Jianbiao Company acted as a guarantor assuming joint and several guarantee liability in the *Personal Housing (Mortgage) Guarantee Loan Contracts* signed between Fudian Bank Dali Branch and the purchasers. On that same day, Jianbiao Company opened a special margin account No. 0990 (account heading 25101) at Fudian Bank Dali Branch and deposited margins at a ratio of 5% of the mortgage loan amounts occurring in the same period (the same day). By May 19, 2011, the total amount of mortgage loan contracts was RMB 35,600,000, and a total of RMB 1,794,000 in margin was deposited (including a duplicate charge of RMB 14,000 corresponding to the mortgage loan of Gong Aizhong).

2. On June 1, 2011, Fudian Bank's internal audit found that the inclusion of Jianbiao Company's Account 0990 margin "Mortgage Loan Guarantee Margin" under "25101 Company Business Acceptance Margin" by Fudian Bank Dali Branch Business Department was an incorrect accounting heading. Jianbiao Company opened Account 6596 (account category: 25102 Company Business Guarantee Margin) on June 17, 2011. The RMB 1,794,000 in Account 0990 was transferred in 11 installments (times) on September 7 of that year to an account ending in 0823 in accordance with bank transfer operating procedures, and then on the same day, the full RMB 1,794,000 was transferred from that account to Account 6596 in a single transaction. Account 0990 was simultaneously closed. During the transfer process, each transfer voucher indicated that the nature of the funds was margin.

3. After Account 6596 was opened, the margins required to be deposited for subsequent mortgage loans were all deposited into this account. From June 29, 2011, the total amount of mortgage loan contracts was RMB 48,690,000, with RMB 2,434,500 in margin receivable, and a total of RMB 2,452,000 in margin was deposited (including a duplicate charge of RMB 17,500 corresponding to the mortgage loan of Dong Xuejun). During this period: On June 18, 2015, because 36 home purchasers had paid off their loans, Fudian Bank Dali Branch returned RMB 468,000 to Jianbiao Company; on December 17, 2015, because the principal and interest on overdue payments for 4 mortgage loans totaling RMB 926,366.24 were unpaid, Fudian Bank Dali Branch, in accordance with the bank's fund use operating procedures, transferred a total of RMB 1,019,000 from Account 6596 using the temporary account "Principal and Interest for Write-off of Temporarily Received Margin Deposits" ending in 0101. After deducting the overdue amount of RMB 926,366.24, the remaining amount of RMB 93,754.25 (including RMB 1,120.49 in interest generated during the margin transfer) was fully transferred back to Account 6596. The current balance of the account is: RMB 1,794,000 + RMB 2,452,000 - RMB 468,000 - RMB 1,019,000 + RMB 93,754.25 = RMB 2,852,754.25.

Opinion of the Yunnan High People's Court at Second Instance:

The issue in dispute in this second instance is: Whether Fudian Bank Dali Branch has a pledge over the funds in the margin account at issue.

I. Regarding the nature of Account 0990 and its relationship with Account 6596: Based on the established facts of the case, the nature of Account 0990 is a margin account, which is undisputed by the parties who opened it. Although there was a defect in the handling of the accounting heading when the account was opened, this does not affect its nature as a special margin account, and the specific handling of the heading is an internal accounting method of the bank, which does not affect the parties' mutual intent to open the account as a margin account. After Account 0990 was closed, all its funds were transferred to margin account 6596, and the margins for subsequent mortgage loans were deposited into that account. The relationship between the two accounts is one of substitution.

II. Regarding whether there was a mutual intent to create a margin pledge between Fudian Bank Dali Branch and Jianbiao Company: Article 210 of the *Property Law of the People's Republic of China* provides: To create a pledge, the parties shall conclude a pledge contract in writing. A pledge contract generally includes the following terms: (1) the type and amount of the secured claim; (2) the time limit for the debtor to perform the obligation; (3) the name, quantity, quality, and condition of the pledged property; (4) the scope of the guarantee; (5) the time for delivery of the pledged property. Although Fudian Bank Dali Branch stated that it could not submit the loan cooperation agreement for the period from October 2010 to August 2011 due to an employee's departure, based on Jianbiao Company's 2010 application for the mortgage facility, the relevant approval materials of Fudian Bank, the *Personal Housing Loan Cooperation Agreements* of 2011 and 2012, the *Personal Housing (Mortgage) Guarantee Loan Contracts*, and the objective fact that Jianbiao Company began depositing margins to guarantee mortgage loans from October 2010, a chain of evidence can be formed. This evidence establishes that a loan cooperation relationship existed between Fudian Bank Dali Branch and Jianbiao Company from October 2010, and that the parties mutually agreed that, from October 11, 2010, Jianbiao Company would provide joint and several guarantee for purchasers of the "Jianbiao Huacheng" project, open a margin account at Fudian Bank Dali Branch, maintain a deposit of margin not less than 5% of the maximum amount of loans disbursed by Fudian Bank Dali Branch to fulfill the company's joint and several guarantee liability, and that, without Fudian Bank Dali Branch's consent, Jianbiao Company could not use the margin for other purposes, and if the guarantor failed to perform the guarantee obligation under the contract, Fudian Bank Dali Branch had the right to directly deduct relevant sums from its account, with the guarantee period lasting until the mortgage contract took effect and the mortgage documents were delivered to Fudian Bank Dali Branch. This mutual intent meets the general requirements of a pledge contract, and therefore, a margin pledge relationship exists between the parties.

III. Regarding whether the pledge was established — i.e., whether the funds were specified and delivered into possession: According to Article 212 of the *Property Law of the People's Republic of China*, "A pledge is established when the pledgor delivers the pledged property to the pledgee," and Article 85 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the *Security Law of the People's Republic of China*, which provides that a creditor may have priority in satisfaction from money that has been specified in the form of a special account, sealed money, margin, etc., and delivered to the creditor for possession as security for a claim, the conditions for the creation of a pledge of money include the specification of the money and the delivery of possession to the creditor. In this case, after the two special margin accounts, 0990 and 6596, were opened, the funds deposited were all noted as margin. There were only two withdrawals: one was the bank's return of the corresponding margin after some home purchasers paid off their loans, and the other was the deduction to satisfy the overdue amounts of home purchasers. The inflows and outflows of funds could all be matched one-to-one. The specification of margin in the form of a special account does not equate to fixity. The funds in the account at issue fluctuated due to business activities, but these fluctuations all corresponded to the margin business. Except for the deposit of margin, the expenditures were all used for the return and deduction of margin, and the account was not used for daily settlement. This meets the requirement of specification of money in the form of a special account under Article 85 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the *Security Law of the People's Republic of China*. Furthermore, possession refers to the factual state of control and management over property. Since the account at issue was opened at Fudian Bank Dali Branch, which actually controlled and managed the account, this satisfies the requirement of delivery of the pledged money into the possession of the creditor. Therefore, the margin pledge at issue was lawfully established. Additionally, the deduction of funds demonstrates that Fudian Bank Dali Branch had the right to dispose of the funds in the account, which is a circumstance of exercising the pledge. Also, the amount of the mortgage facility applied for by Jianbiao Company was RMB 450,000,000, and the credit facility granted by Fudian Bank Dali Branch was also RMB 450,000,000. Therefore, Yang Fengming's claim that the maximum amount in the margin account exceeded the corresponding total loan amount cannot be sustained.

In summary, the first-instance judgment found some facts unclear and applied the law improperly. The appeal request of Appellant Fudian Bank Co., Ltd., Dali Branch has factual and legal basis and should be upheld. As Fudian Bank Dali Branch requested in its claims that the amount to be adjudicated is the funds of RMB 2.8 million and interest thereon in Account No. 6596 frozen by the first-instance court, the court of second instance renders judgment within the scope of the parties' claims. Meanwhile, pursuant to Article 213 of the Property Law of the People's Republic of China, the effect of a pledge extends to the fruits of the pledged property, and the interest claimed by the Bank is also upheld. The Yunnan High People's Court, in accordance with Articles 210, 212, and 213 of the Property Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 85 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Guarantee Law of the People's Republic of China, subparagraph (2) of paragraph 1 of Article 170 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and Article 312 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered judgment on December 28, 2018, as follows:

1. Set aside the civil judgment (2018) Yun 29 Min Chu No. 19 of the Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture Intermediate People's Court of Yunnan Province;

2. Confirm that Fudian Bank Co., Ltd., Dali Branch has a right of pledge over the deposit of RMB 2.8 million and interest thereon in the margin account numbered "9700xxxxxxxxxx6596" opened by Dali Jianbiao Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. with the Business Department of Fudian Bank Co., Ltd., Dali Branch;

3. The deposit of RMB 2.8 million and interest thereon in the margin account numbered "9700xxxxxxxxxx6596" opened by Dali Jianbiao Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. with the Business Department of Fudian Bank Co., Ltd., Dali Branch shall not be executed.

This judgment is final.

The ruling on enforcement objection (2018) Yun 29 Zhi Yi No. 1 of the Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture Intermediate People's Court of Yunnan Province shall automatically become invalid upon the effective date of this judgment.
